_camera_note: USB camera: /dev/video0 (width/height = capture size). Pi Camera V2/NoIR on CSI: csi://0 with width/height 1640x1232 (the sensor's own size: the detector can then zoom into the zones and see more pixels), rate 15, sensor_mode 3; the web page gets the picture shrunk to display_width. Add "rotate": 180 (or 90/270) to the camera block if the picture is upside down.
_detector_note: Better with distant cats: {"type": "yolo", "engine": "models/yolov8n_768x1024.fp16.engine", "min_conf": 0.3, "max_fps": 4} (see README: 'Detection range'). max_fps limits how often the detector runs; the video keeps its frame rate.
